summaryText:
Hi,

Here is the end-of-day summary for 8 September 2026.
Total work logged: 10h 55m.

Tickets worked on today:

AEME-6282 — 
  Customers exploited multi-tab checkout to redeem and cancel rewards points on 22 UAE orders. 18 remediated via PC-48490. 4 remain with insufficient GCRM balance — partial redemption script prepared under PC-53503. (45m)

AEME-6499 — 
  Five UAE orders reported stuck. Four progressed to COMPLETED. One order remains at SHIPPING_REQUESTED after partial cancellation and color swap. Parallel investigation launched for DB state verification and root cause analysis. (35m)

AEME-6540 — 
  Two UAE orders' trade-in devices rejected by NorthLadder, triggering clawback. Both Checkout.com payment authorizations declined. Clawback processes stuck in RUNNING state. Remediation script pending user confirmation to re-trigger clawback from payment action step. (2h 0m)

GMT-19192 — 

GMT-20796 — 
  Investigation in progress — only lock file exists, no RCA completed. DB state verification and root cause analysis pending. Next step is to complete investigation and write RCA. (45m)

PC-53768 — Script to copy paymentInfo to clawback PaymentTransaction and retrigger ClawbackProcess
  No RCA file exists — investigation not yet started. Ticket details and root cause analysis pending. Next step is to fetch ticket, investigate, and write RCA. (1h 0m)

RT-702249 — 
  Investigation in progress — only lock file exists, no RCA completed. DB state verification and root cause analysis pending. Next step is to complete investigation and write RCA. (35m)

SAHME-3357 — 
  Fourteen ZA orders with SMC errors investigated. Eleven remediated after SMC team completed mappings. Three remain in ERROR — unmapped A36 device model, invalid identity document, and invalid product ID. Awaits SMC team confirmations to retrigger via PC-52678. (1h 0m)

SAHME-3407 — 
  No RCA file exists — investigation not yet completed. Only residual EOD generation logs found. Next step is to investigate ticket details and write RCA. (1h 15m)

SAHME-3409 — 

SAHME-3421 — 
  No proper RCA content — file contains residual EOD generation logs from prior run. Investigation in progress. Next step is to complete investigation and write RCA. (45m)

SAME-3958 — 
  SA sales report missing affiliate_name and multistore_verificationcode columns. SaSalesReport.groovy needs two new @ColumnMethod handlers. Infrastructure exists in type system — feature gap, not a bug. Code modification requiring sapreporting extension build and deployment. (2h 15m)

SAME-3962 — 
  Refund failure investigation for 18 SA-region orders. Parallel fan-out launched for Kibana logs, DB state, codebase trace, and PC ticket search. Root cause and remediation pending completion of parallel investigation.

Open tickets:

PC-53768 [To do] — Script to copy paymentInfo to clawback PaymentTransaction and retrigger ClawbackProcess
  Todo: Investigation/implementation pending.

PC-53503 [To do] — Redeem rewards points (partial) for 4 AE orders - AEME-6282
  Todo: Investigation/implementation pending.

PC-53529 [To do] — [SAM-24720] Create DB cleanup cronjobs for SMI cluster
  Todo: Investigation/implementation pending.

SAM-24720 [Code Review] —  Update or create Cronjob for autocleanup
  Todo: Hi ~@email,
   Please find below details : 
SAP incident : https://me.sap.com/cases/002075129500011086542026/overview
Sa

Thanks,
Aryan
